name: Krugersdorp
story: The first named place after Johannesburg in the historical sequence opens a story about the towns west of the city. Krugersdorp’s old courthouse now houses a museum of local history and culture.
history: The old magistrate’s court became the Krugersdorp Museum, established in 1993.

experience.activity: Plan a separate excursion to the waterfall and garden near Krugersdorp; check travel from the historical rail route.
